name: Berguisa

attributes.attribute: goddess of crafts among the Celts
her cult stood in eastern Burgundy

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Berguisa is a Continental Celtic goddess. She was the goddess of crafts among the Celts. Her cult stood in what is now eastern Burgundy. The god Ucuetis was her consort. The source gives little more than this short note.

okr.objective: Berguisa is a Continental goddess of crafts united with the god Ucuetis in eastern Burgundy.
key_results: Berguisa is a goddess of crafts
Her cult stood in what is now eastern Burgundy
Her consort is the god Ucuetis
